name: Radiant Proof
description: Bring back Seraph Feathers from the summit beyond the Void Sanctum.

dialogue.offer: Some call the Celestial Spire a myth. Three Seraph Feathers would prove the summit is real.
dialogue.in_progress: The path rises beyond the Void Sanctum. Few who attempt it return.
dialogue.ready: Even in shadow, these feathers shine. No skeptic can deny this evidence.
dialogue.completed: Your ascent has changed everything we understand about the heavens.
